info.title: OpenData Best - Real-time Web Intelligence & x402 APIs
info.description: Real-time structured web data APIs paid per delivered row in USDC via x402 (Base). No subscriptions or API keys required; zero-row / upstream failures are never charged.
info.x-guidance: Structured real-time web intelligence APIs paid per delivered row in USDC via x402. All endpoints are synchronous at POST /s/<site>/v1/<endpoint> and also exposed over stateless MCP at POST /mcp. Supports x402 v2 'upto' (Permit2, charged strictly for delivered rows) and 'exact' (EIP-3009). Empty/0-row (404), invalid input (422), timeout (504), and upstream failures (502) are never charged.
